The correct value is 2.1 V, which is what the example's OWN closing Note uses. (b) The stem asks for V_AB, V_BC and V_DC, but the working never derives V_AB - yet the Note quotes 4.2 V for it. Both are supplied here, consistent with R_AB = 2 ohm and I = 2.1 A.
find:
iii) Voltage drop across BC is \(V_{BC}\)
\(V_{BC} = I \times 1 = 2.1 \times 2.1 = 2\) V
